preview_browser.command: CHAT_EVIDENCE=<evidence directory> MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS="$PWD/mise.toml" mise exec -- npx playwright test -c .local-chat-test/preview.config.ts e2e/chat.spec.ts e2e/form.spec.ts --grep 'Chat action advances|Form submits'

scenarios.name: Button actions become posted user turns; new reply actions work and historical controls remain locked after text sends
Edited forms submit current Field and Input values, preserve parameters, and lock retained values in EN and AR
Host veto observes the OpenUI action without posting, appending or locking it
Pending approval rejects competing work; reset or stop invalidates a late approval
Response and AsyncIterable streams publish partial replies before completion; Stop preserves partial text and prevents late updates
Server errors show Blocked with Retry; retry reuses the action turn and preserves its lock
Local server accepts exactly 16 KiB and 12 action turns, rejects excess and malformed actions, and normalizes deterministically in each locale

setup_corrections: Registered disposable API middleware before Vite SPA fallback.
Aligned form assertions with the upstream ActionEvent contract: form values are grouped by form name. Re-ran the complete targeted consumer driver successfully.
scope: Real source components in Chromium and real built server request parser on localhost. Synthetic responses only; no external model or tenant services.

cleanup.previewExitReason: Stopped with SIGINT after successful browser run
